title: Demystifying Game Audio Codecs: A Practical Guide

s1.description: Who is speaking, what a codec setting affects, and the outline

s2.description: What digital audio is, the cost of raw PCM, Titanfall as an example of the tradeoff, and codec basics: types, levers and gotchas

s3.description: The past: a short history of game audio codecs, sample-based audio on early consoles, then ADPCM and MP3

s4.description: The modern toolbox: Opus, Vorbis, AAC, XMA, ATRAC9 and a decision framework

s5.description: The frontier, arranged by the problem each technology might solve: sound effects in memory (QOA), spatial delivery (APAC and IAMF), voice chat (Opus 1.6, IVAS, neural codecs) and generated voices, then barriers and outlook
